judge_input.description:
- Fixed null input in Langfuse dashboard for GoogleLLMService
- Falls back to adapter get_messages_for_logging() for universal LLMContext
- Ensures format conversion for Google/Gemini, including system → system_instruction
- Fixes empty message list ([]) serialization

Works with OpenAILLMContext/GoogleLLMContext and universal LLMContext.
